recognize_zh: 網狀纖維銀染色下，黑色纖維在整個骨髓腔中瀰漫、密集交錯成網，並有粗厚成束、呈流線狀排列的纖維，只剩少數脂肪空腔；這種瀰漫高密度且粗纖維增生（約 MF-2 至 MF-3）是原發性骨髓纖維化纖維化期的特徵。
features: Diffuse, dense increase in reticulin fibers throughout the marrow space
Extensive intersections forming a tight meshwork around individual cells
Coarse, thickened fiber bundles with a streaming, parallel arrangement
Background cells pale pink on counterstain with few residual fat spaces
Collagen deposition and osteosclerosis cannot be assessed on this stain alone
describe_en: Reticulin-stained bone marrow trephine section shows a diffuse and dense increase in reticulin fibers with extensive intersections and coarse, thickened bundles arranged in a streaming pattern, enveloping residual hematopoietic cells. Few fat spaces remain. The degree of fibrosis corresponds to at least MF-2, and MF-3 if accompanied by collagen and osteosclerosis on trichrome and H&E. Findings are consistent with advanced marrow fibrosis, as seen in the fibrotic stage of primary myelofibrosis; correlation with megakaryocyte morphology and JAK2, CALR or MPL mutation status is required.

ddx.dx: Post-polycythemia vera or post-essential thrombocythemia myelofibrosis
ddx.vs: The reticulin pattern is indistinguishable; the prior documented PV or ET history defines secondary myelofibrosis.
Hairy cell leukemia shows fine, evenly spaced reticulin around a CD20+ annexin A1+ infiltrate rather than coarse streaming bundles.
MDS with fibrosis has small hypolobated megakaryocytes and multilineage dysplasia rather than the clustered bizarre megakaryocytes of PMF.
Carcinoma shows cohesive epithelial clusters that are keratin positive within the fibrotic stroma.
